# Delavnica

Static, browser-local tools. No remote processing API. Agent/provider privacy is separate from site-local processing.

- [Agent guide](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/agents/)
- [Versioned schemas and catalog](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/tools.json)
- [Generator EMŠO](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/emso/)
- [Generator SI DDV](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/davcna-stevilka/)
- [Preverjanje JWT](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/jwt/)
- [Formatiranje JSON](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/json/)
- [Sparkasse CSV v QIF](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/sparkasse-csv-qif/)
- [Združevanje PDF-jev](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/pdf/)
- [Formatiranje XML](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/xml/)
- [Generator JWT](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/jwt-generator/)
- [Sprememba velikosti slik](https://delavnica.kocmut.com/image-resizer/)
